Native downloads are byte-preserving storage copies into the participant outputs and archive. The evaluator did not calculate, edit, repair or regenerate a deliverable.

confidence: High for preserved native-original/output byte equality and deterministic checks; E2 provenance depends on cited actual UI observations; internal causation unresolved
